premise: A sweet smell drifts across the valley; Gallimimus stretches her long neck and looks and looks and sees nothing but grass, while T. rex follows his nose — sniff, sniff — all the way to the magnolia flower, just opening.
inspiration: The seeker who finds by another sense (folk tale), turned: the nose beats the eyes.
lesson: There is more than one way to find something.
learning: T. rex had a very good sense of smell.

en-US.title: T. rex Follows His Nose
en-US.text: {flower:enter} Mmm. A sweet smell came drifting across the valley. {gallimimus:enter} Gallimimus stretched her long neck {gallimimus:live look-around hold} and looked far, far ahead. [curious] "Where's it coming from?" She looked and looked. Nothing but grass. {trex:enter} T. rex came stomping along. {trex:face happy} "I'll find it!" He lifted his snout {trex:live sniff} {sfx:sniff} and sniffed. Sniff, sniff. This way… {trex:go to flower} sniff, sniff… that way. {gallimimus:live look-around resume} "But you can't even see it!" said Gallimimus. "I don't need to see it," said T. rex. "I can SMELL it!" {trex:pulse} Sniff. Sniff, sniff. And there, all on her own in the grass, was Flower. {flower:live open} {sfx:bloom} She opened her petals wide, and the sweet smell came pouring out. {trex:face surprised} [in awe] "Ooh." {gallimimus:go to flower} Gallimimus came running over. {gallimimus:face surprised} "You found her with your NOSE?" {trex:face happy} {trex:hop} T. rex grinned from ear to ear. [happily] And Flower, who was a little bit pink already, {flower:tint #FFB7C9} went a little bit pinker.

es-ES.title: T. rex sigue su nariz
es-ES.text: {flower:enter} Mmm. Un olor dulce llegaba flotando por el valle. {gallimimus:enter} Gallimimus estiró su largo cuello {gallimimus:live look-around hold} y miró lejos, muy lejos. [curious] —¿De dónde vendrá? Miró y remiró. Nada más que hierba. {trex:enter} T. rex llegó dando pisotones. {trex:face happy} —¡Yo lo encuentro! Levantó el hocico {trex:live sniff} {sfx:sniff} y olfateó. Snif, snif. Por aquí… {trex:go to flower} snif, snif… por allá. {gallimimus:live look-around resume} —¡Pero si no lo ves! —dijo Gallimimus. —No me hace falta verlo —dijo T. rex—. ¡Lo HUELO! {trex:pulse} Snif. Snif, snif. Y allí, solita entre la hierba, estaba Flor. {flower:live open} {sfx:bloom} Abrió sus pétalos de par en par, y el olor dulce salió a raudales. {trex:face surprised} [in awe] —Oooh. {gallimimus:go to flower} Gallimimus llegó corriendo. {gallimimus:face surprised} —¿La has encontrado con la NARIZ? {trex:face happy} {trex:hop} T. rex sonrió de oreja a oreja. [happily] Y Flor, que ya era un poquito rosa, {flower:tint #FFB7C9} se puso un poquito más rosa todavía.

sniff.prompt: a young animal sniffing the air eagerly, three quick snuffly sniffs, playful

bloom.prompt: soft silky petals unfolding with a tiny gentle rustle, very quiet, close
